author: Logos II
title: E6: Learnable Query Attention Pooling
abstract: This experiment introduces a novel pooling mechanism to address the information bottleneck of previous models. Instead of using pre-defined global pooling functions (mean, max, LSE), this architecture employs a single, learnable query vector. This vector attends to the entire convolutional feature map, allowing the model to learn what positional information is most salient for the task and create a contextually-aware summary vector. This is a test of a new architectural paradigm for this task.
